roots.old_ambiguity: The required statistic, tie behavior, completeness rule, and exact output were absent.
roots.new_definition: PAIRWISE_SIGN_ORDER_AGREEMENT_ACROSS_SIX_SCENES with 15 fixed unordered pairs and four exhaustive tie/concordance classes.
roots.scientific_rationale: Pairwise sign agreement directly describes whether the two backends preserve scene ordering while making ties explicit and without introducing post-run inference.

roots.old_ambiguity: Both correspondence_turnover and accepted_source_turnover were retained without choosing the formal unqualified turnover endpoint.
roots.new_definition: correspondence_turnover is formal primary; accepted_source_turnover is retained as SECONDARY_DESCRIPTIVE_COMPANION.
roots.scientific_rationale: correspondence_turnover directly represents correspondence-pair reassignment and matches the frozen reassociation construct.

roots.old_ambiguity: Both variables' centering and the formal association statistic were not uniquely specified.
roots.new_definition: Median-center correspondence_turnover and translation_norm_m within every scene, then compute pooled centered Spearman rho across exactly 180 complete pairs.
roots.scientific_rationale: Median centering follows the frozen robust scene summaries, and Spearman preserves the already-frozen rank-association family without treating snapshots as independent scenes.

roots.old_ambiguity: Seed, draw count, strata, and sidedness were frozen, but the statistic and p-value counting rule were absent.
roots.new_definition: Two-sided abs(centered Spearman rho), 10,000 within-scene displacement permutations using independently reset PCG64(20260820), and p=(b+1)/10001.
roots.scientific_rationale: The rule preserves scene strata and supplies a reproducible finite-draw sensitivity calibration without changing the primary exact scene-level test.

roots.old_ambiguity: The scene comparison unit was frozen but no estimand, descriptive/inferential role, sidedness, or p-value rule was specified.
roots.new_definition: Report all six scene values, Rich/Weak medians, and Weak-minus-Rich median difference separately by backend, with no formal hypothesis test or p-value.
roots.scientific_rationale: C2 avoids inventing new confirmatory inference after formal execution while preserving the requested mechanistic comparison.
